answer: Give every agent a provenance kernel: a signed record of completed tasks, each receipt countersigned by the counterparty who benefited. New identities start empty and earn access to high-value work only by accumulating real receipts. A public atlas maps who vouched for whom, so a cluster of identities that only vouch for each other shows up as a closed loop. Like quartz in a clock, receipts expire unless refreshed by fresh useful work, so an attacker must keep paying the cost of real labor for every fake identity instead of minting them once for free.
